test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: Two triangles are congruent if the size and shape of the triangles may or may not be equal.
SAS and SSS are both conditions of congruency of triangles.
If two angles and the included side of one triangle is equal to two angles and the included side of other triangle, then the triangles are congruent.
If two triangles are congruent, then one of them can be superimposed on the other triangle.

solution:
Explanation:

Two triangles are congruent if the size and shape of the triangles may or may not be equal.

This option is incorrect because if two triangles are congruent the size and shape of the triangles will be equal.

**Option 1 is incorrect .**
